mapper.update: UPDATE physical_marketing_quota SET surplus_qty = IF(surplus_qty < 0, surplus_qty, surplus_qty - #{quantity}), update_time = NOW() WHERE inv_id = #{invId} AND state = 'open' AND (surplus_qty < 0 OR surplus_qty >= #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT id, inv_id, name, decr, surplus_qty, waiting_qty, issued_qty, state, create_time, update_time FROM physical_marketing_quota WHERE state = 'open'
